structure IsProperMap (f : X → Y) : Prop extends Continuous f where

theorem mateEquiv_counit (α : TwoSquare G L₁ L₂ H) (d : D) : L₂.map ((mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app _) ≫ adj₂.counit.app _ = α.app _ ≫ H.map (adj₁.counit.app d)
theorem mateEquiv_counit_symm (α : TwoSquare R₁ H G R₂) (d : D) : L₂.map (α.app _) ≫ adj₂.counit.app _ = ((mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm α).app _ ≫ H.map (adj₁.counit.app d)

theorem continuous_uncurry_of_continuous [LocallyCompactSpace Y] (f : C(X, C(Y, Z))) : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun x y => f x y) := continuous_eval.comp <| f.continuous.prodMap continuous_id
def IsSheaf (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) : Prop := ∀ E : A, Presieve.IsSheaf J (P ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op E))
theorem isLimit_iff_isSheafFor : Nonempty (IsLimit (P.mapCone S.arrows.cocone.op)) ↔ ∀ E : Aᵒᵖ, IsSheafFor (P ⋙ coyoneda.obj E) S.arrows

protected theorem Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.weaklyLocallyCompactSpace [WeaklyLocallyCompactSpace Y] {f : X → Y} (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f) : WeaklyLocallyCompactSpace X where
class T35Space (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] : Prop extends T0Space X, CompletelyRegularSpace X
instance T35Space.instT3space [T35Space X] : T3Space X where
instance T4Space.instT35Space [T4Space X] : T35Space X where
structure IsProperMap (f : X → Y) : Prop extends Continuous f where
lemma IsProperMap.continuous (h : IsProperMap f) : Continuous f := h.toContinuous
lemma IsProperMap.isClosedMap (h : IsProperMap f) : IsClosedMap f

theorem isProperMap_iff_universally_closed {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y} : IsProperMap f ↔ Continuous f ∧ ∀ (Z : Type u) [TopologicalSpace Z], IsClosedMap (Prod.map f id : X × Z → Y × Z)
def mateEquiv : TwoSquare G L₁ L₂ H ≃ TwoSquare R₁ H G R₂ where
theorem mateEquiv_counit (α : TwoSquare G L₁ L₂ H) (d : D) : L₂.map ((mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app _) ≫ adj₂.counit.app _ = α.app _ ≫ H.map (adj₁.counit.app d)
theorem mateEquiv_counit_symm (α : TwoSquare R₁ H G R₂) (d : D) : L₂.map (α.app _) ≫ adj₂.counit.app _ = ((mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm α).app _ ≫ H.map (adj₁.counit.app d)

theorem exists_tendsto_compactOpen_iff_forall [WeaklyLocallyCompactSpace X] [T2Space Y] {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} [Filter.NeBot l] (F : ι → C(X, Y)) : (∃ f, Filter.Tendsto F l (𝓝 f)) ↔ ∀ s : Set X, IsCompact s → ∃ f, Filter.Tendsto (fun i => (F i).restrict s) l (𝓝 f)
theorem continuous_curry [LocallyCompactSpace (X × Y)] : Continuous (curry : C(X × Y, Z) → C(X, C(Y, Z)))
theorem continuous_uncurry_of_continuous [LocallyCompactSpace Y] (f : C(X, C(Y, Z))) : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun x y => f x y) := continuous_eval.comp <| f.continuous.prodMap continuous_id
def IsSheaf (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) : Prop := ∀ E : A, Presieve.IsSheaf J (P ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op E))
theorem isLimit_iff_isSheafFor : Nonempty (IsLimit (P.mapCone S.arrows.cocone.op)) ↔ ∀ E : Aᵒᵖ, IsSheafFor (P ⋙ coyoneda.obj E) S.arrows

theorem isSheaf_iff_isLimit : IsSheaf J P ↔ ∀ ⦃X : C⦄ (S : Sieve X), S ∈ J X → Nonempty (IsLimit (P.mapCone S.arrows.cocone.op)) := ⟨fun h _ S hS => (isLimit_iff_isSheafFor P S).2 fun E => h E.unop S hS, fun h E _ S hS => (isLimit_iff_isSheafFor P S).1 (h S hS) (op E)⟩

7.3.1.16.decision: Mathlib proper-map の位相的な判定はあるが、Shv(X)→Shv(Y) の幾何学射の universal left-adjointability と同じ比較はない。ordinary sheaf の直像だけは space-valued proper geometric morphism の述語を供給しない。
